title: Moondance Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutMoondance ~ 25 Cypress Hill Road ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Moondance is a comfortable, classic/vintage pet friendly (dogs only) bungalow located in Old Seagrove, with 3 bedrooms/2 baths, sleeping a maximum of 6 guests. At 940sf and designed as a replica of the first Seaside cottages, Moondance has a 10' x 27.5' private heated pool (3-5' depth, heating fee is additional) and neighborhood beach access within a 5-minute stroll; a 90-second walk takes you into Seaside. Maximum 2 dogs allowed; breed and weight must be disclosed at booking. A better value this close to Seaside cannot be found! On-street parking is not allowed; please note parking spaces below and plan accordingly. Please note - visitor's dogs are NOT allowed on the beach at any time in Walton County. ** Need more room? Take a peek at Tupelo Honey, located next door. These two homes rented together are perfect for multi-family vacations! ** Main Level: Open living area. Dining table seats 6. Fully equipped kitchen. Laundry. Screened porch. #1 Bedroom has a Queen bed #2 Bedroom has a Queen bed #3 Bedroom has 2 Twin beds 2 Full baths, both with walk-in showers Laundry Closet (located in outside room off dining area). Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 3 Flat Screen TVs, 1 DVD player Distinctive Features Private heated pool (heating fee is additional) 10' x 27.5' with 3-5' depth Pet friendly (dogs only; maximum 2 allowed, breed/weight must be disclosed) - Please note - visitor's dogs are NOT allowed on the beach at any time in Walton County. 5-minute walk to beach 90-second walk into Seaside Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 2 vehicles (on-street parking is not allowed, so please plan accordingly) 2 Queen beds, 2 Twin beds 2 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 2 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, screened porch, outdoor porch furniture, outdoor laundry closet with stackable washer/driyer, outdoor shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, electric range, refrigerator with icemaker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (90-seconds) Grayton Beach (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
